name: Risha
description: Risha was the first planet orbiting the star Rish in the Rishi system. Located in the Abrion sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a toxic hothouse. The planet did not support Human-like life, as its surface was covered with molten rivers and steaming lakes of chemicals.
